verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration-services provider aimed at founders and startups, so accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio deals or founder-community pricing are a fair question for it. The pack documents only flat case pricing and a Forbes AI 50 usage metric. The Forbes figure is a customer statistic, not a partnership or discount program, so it earns no credit, and no YC, accelerator or VC-portfolio arrangement is documented.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents startup-ecosystem programs — YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, or founder-community pricing
